stock.description: China Smarter Energy Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the solar energy business in the People’s Republic of China. It operates solar power plants and distributes solar power stations. As of 31 December 2023, its installed capacity was approximately 172 megawatts. The company also engages in the trading of securities. The company was formerly known as Rising Development Holdings Limited and changed its name to China Smarter Energy Group Holdings Limited in February 2015. China Smarter Energy Group Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
